# 🌍 VC_WorldArena — Valorant Map Manager for ValoCraft

> **Instantly download and load real Valorant maps into your Minecraft server.**  
> One command. Six iconic maps. Zero manual setup.

---

## 📖 What is VC_WorldArena?

**VC_WorldArena** is a companion plugin for [ValoCraft](#) that handles everything related to arena worlds.  
It automatically **downloads**, **extracts**, and **loads** pre-built Valorant map replicas as Minecraft worlds — ready to be used as arenas in your tactical matches.

No more copying folders, no manual world loading, no configuration headaches.  
Just type one command and your map is live.

---

## 🗺️ Available Maps

Six iconic Valorant maps are available out of the box, hosted and ready to download:

| Map | Sites | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| 🏛️ **Haven** | A · B · C | Three-site classic — the iconic map with a middle courtyard |
| 🌊 **Pearl** | A · B | Underwater city with long sightlines and tight corridors |
| 🌿 **Lotus** | A · B · C | Ancient ruins with rotating doors and three-site chaos |
| 🏙️ **Ascent** | A · B | Open mid with mechanical doors — the fan favourite |
| 🕳️ **Abyss** | A · B | No outer walls — fall off the edge and you're gone |
| ⚡ **Fracture** | A · B | Unique H-shaped layout with dual attacker entry points |

> Maps are built by the community and hosted on **ommo.me**.

---

## ⚡ Quick Start

```
# 1 — See all available maps
/vcw templates

# 2 — Download and load a map (async, progress shown in real time)
/vcw create my_haven haven

# 3 — Teleport into the world to set up spawns
/vcw tp my_haven

# 4 — Link to a ValoCraft arena
/vcw link my_haven haven_arena
```

That's it. Your map is downloaded, extracted, and registered as a Bukkit world in seconds.

---

## 🛠️ Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/vcw create <name> <template>` | Download a map and load it as a world |
| `/vcw templates` | List all available map templates with aliases |
| `/vcw list` | Show all managed worlds and their status |
| `/vcw tp <name>` | Teleport into a world (auto-loads if needed) |
| `/vcw link <world> <arena>` | Link a world to a ValoCraft arena |
| `/vcw load <name>` | Load a previously created world |
| `/vcw unload <name>` | Unload a world (keeps the folder) |
| `/vcw delete <name> confirm` | Permanently delete a world |
| `/vcw info <name>` | Detailed info — template, size, players, linked arena |
| `/vcw cache clear` | Clear cached ZIP files to free disk space |

**Aliases:** `/vw`, `/vcarena`

---

## 🔒 World Protection

Arena worlds are automatically protected:

- ❌ Block breaking and placing are **disabled** for non-admins
- 🛡️ Fall damage, fire damage, and void damage are **cancelled** outside of matches
- 💤 No mob spawning, no weather cycle, no daylight cycle
- 💾 Auto-save is disabled — worlds stay clean between sessions

---

## 📦 How Downloads Work

When you run `/vcw create`, the plugin:

1. **Downloads** the map ZIP from `ommo.me` in an **async thread** — the server never lags
2. Shows **real-time progress** in your action bar (`Downloading... 234 / 890 KB`)
3. **Extracts** the ZIP directly into your server's world container folder
4. **Flattens** the folder structure automatically (no nested folders)
5. **Cleans up** `uid.dat` and `session.lock` for a fresh world
6. **Loads** the world on the main thread and teleports you in

Downloaded ZIPs are **cached** — if you recreate a world from the same template, no re-download is needed.

---

## 🔗 ValoCraft Integration

VC_WorldArena is designed to work hand-in-hand with **ValoCraft**:

```
# After creating your world and setting up spawns:
/vc arene create haven_arena
/vcw link my_haven haven_arena

# Set attacker and defender spawns (stand on the spot):
/vc arene setattaquespawn haven_arena
/vc arene setdefancespawn haven_arena

# Define bomb sites with the zone selector axe:
/vc arene setzone haven_arena 1
/vc arene setzone haven_arena 2
/vc arene setzone haven_arena 3

# Start the match:
/vc forcestart my_haven
```

---

| | |
|--|--|

| **Java** | 21+ |
| **Required dependency** | [ValoCraft](#) |
| **Internet access** | Required for first download of each map |
| **Disk space** | ~50–150 MB per map |
